changelog: - **Trial end shown on the record and the board, set or extended by hand, and an undated trial made visible** (#2553, story #2392). New `PATCH /api/mentorship/[id]/trial` (`{ trialEndsAt: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }`, stored as midnight UTC): ADMIN of the record's tenant or its owner (`mentorId`), `requireCapability(orgId, 'pipeline')`, by-id lookup through `tenantWhere`/`withinTenant`, every other caller 403. The rule is the pure `planTrialEndChange()` in `src/lib/trialReminderRule.ts`: only a record in `TRIAL_ACTIVE`/`TRIAL_EXPIRED` (`409 not_in_trial`), today or later by UTC day (`400 in_the_past`), same UTC day is a no-op; shortening is allowed. The write is conditional on the stage it planned against (`409 conflict`), logged as `trial.end_changed` (old → new day) in `ActivityLog`, and a `TRIAL_EXPIRED` record extended into the future returns to `TRIAL_ACTIVE` as a human move (StatusChange + `pipeline.stage_change` + `emitStageChange`). `TrialReminder` claim rows are left alone on purpose: a mark already mailed is never mailed again, and the marks still ahead in the new window fire on their day. New attention reason `trial_no_end_date` (from the shared `isTrialMissingEndDate()`), a `TrialEndPanel` on `/admin/candidates/[id]` and `/mentor/mentees/[id]`, and a `TrialEndChip` (end day + days left, or a red "date missing" badge) on both boards. `TRIAL_EXPIRED_STAGE_KEY` moves into the dependency-free rule and is re-exported from `programTemplates.ts`. Unit tests `scripts/test/trial-end-change.test.mjs`; e2e `e2e/trial-end-extend.spec.ts`.

en: Every trial now shows when it ends — on the record and on its board card, with the days left. The owner or an admin can extend it right there; an extended trial that had already run out goes back to "trial running", and reminders already sent are not sent again. A running trial without an end date is flagged in red so it gets one.
tr: Her deneme artık ne zaman bittiğini gösteriyor — kayıtta ve pano kartında, kalan gün sayısıyla. Kaydın sahibi ya da bir yönetici bitişi oradan uzatabilir; süresi dolmuş bir deneme uzatılınca yeniden "deneme sürüyor" aşamasına döner ve gönderilmiş hatırlatmalar tekrar gönderilmez. Bitiş tarihi olmayan bir deneme kırmızıyla işaretlenir, böylece tarihi girilir.
de: Jede Testphase zeigt jetzt, wann sie endet — am Datensatz und auf seiner Board-Karte, mit den verbleibenden Tagen. Der Verantwortliche oder ein Admin kann sie direkt dort verlängern; eine bereits abgelaufene Testphase kehrt dabei zu „Testphase läuft“ zurück, und bereits verschickte Erinnerungen gehen nicht noch einmal raus. Eine laufende Testphase ohne Enddatum wird rot markiert, damit sie eines bekommt.
